findings.text: Public bug handling surface includes warning formatting tolerant of absent format and optional register context, two trap classifiers distinguished by resolved entry versus raw address input, and a global reset of single fire markers across core and module tables.

Single fire warnings are delivered at most once until global reset. Completed markers cause immediate warning classification without further output. Suppressed test warnings return warning classification without consuming the single fire budget.

Custom format and cut marker output is omitted only when explicitly disabled by flag, with register arguments supplied only when argument flag is present. Warning classification routes to warning accounting with location and taint, while non warning routes to critical bug diagnostic with location when available, and unknown addresses yield none classification.
Both trap classifiers pair warning RCU entry and exit around classification using the returned nesting state. Global once reset iterates module tables under scoped RCU protection.

Build identifier surface includes initializers for file backed and memory backed readers with fetch and cleanup, plus parsers for non faulting mapping, faulting mapping, explicit file, and raw note buffer, together with a boot initializer populating the kernel image identifier from linked notes.

Observed reader state includes a caller buffer with size plus file handle and sleep permission in file mode, or a data pointer with size in memory mode, plus current folio reference with base offset and local mapping address and a sticky error code.

Memory mode requires requested span within data extent. File mode rejects requests larger than caller buffer, rejects offset wrap, rejects secret mappings, permits sleeping read only when flagged, otherwise requires cached up to date folios and either returns direct mapping for contained spans or stages straddling spans through caller buffer.

File parsing accepts only recognized magic with executable or shared object type, then dispatches on class to matching program header walk. Header count is capped at a fixed bound and header table span is checked for wrap. Only note segments are examined.

Note scanning requires room for header plus minimal name, checks aligned name and descriptor extents against segment end, matches numeric type and short name with bounded positive descriptor length, then copies identifier bytes, zero pads remainder to maximum, and optionally reports actual length.

Pointers returned by fetch become invalid after later fetches and must be copied before next call. Failures present as null with sticky error or negative status. Folio acquisition fails rather than faulting when entry is missing or not up to date.

Mapping parsers require attached file and differ only in sleep permission, explicit file parsing always permits sleeping, buffer parsing treats input as note area at base offset without length report, and boot initialization derives note extent from linker start and stop symbols into a read only after init global.
Observed numeric facts are note type three for build identifier, program header walk cap two hundred fifty six, and file parser staging buffer sixty four bytes.
Small utility surface includes unsigned byte string comparison, ordered I/O signature matching, and oops nesting control.

Comparison treats bytes as unsigned and yields zero for full equality, otherwise sign ordered by first differing pair. With efficient unaligned support it first compares whole machine words with safe unaligned loads before trailing bytes.
Signature verification reads I/O bytes in order alongside expected bytes and reports success only when every byte matches, otherwise failure on first difference.
Oops nesting counter increments on entry. On exit the console is unblanked and the logging daemon is woken exactly when the counter returns to zero.

Coherency surface includes reference release, registration and removal of instances, memregion invalidation over an address range, a predicate for presence of any instance, and sized allocation of instances.
Global instance list uses a read write semaphore. Registration and removal take write hold, while invalidation walks and presence test take read hold.

Allocation requires operations with primary callback and otherwise zeroes storage and initializes operations pointer with list linkage and reference count. Per instance progress requires operations, completion callback is optional. Memregion requests apply primary action to every instance followed by completion action to every instance, stopping on first error.
Observed instance state includes operations pointer, list node, and reference count whose release frees the container. Invalidation parameters pair a physical address with a length.

Checksum surface includes fast header checksum over word count, partial accumulation with prior sum, full buffer checksum, and transport pseudo header combination without final fold, plus a sixty four to thirty two bit reduction helper.

Core accumulation compensates odd start alignment and trailing odd byte with endian dependent placement, aligns through short to word width, accumulates words with carry tracking, folds to sixteen bits, and swaps bytes when starting odd. Header and full variants complement the accumulator, partial variant adds prior sum with end around carry.
Pseudo header combination adds source and destination addresses with length and protocol using endian dependent placement, then reduces the wide sum by repeated folding of high and low halves.

Closure surface includes single and counted reference release, waitlist wake and conditional enrollment, blocking synchronization with plain timed and return variants, debug creation and destruction, and a lock free list order reversal helper.

When counted references reach zero, a barrier is observed and rearm marker cleared. With callback present and destructor marker absent the count is reinitialized and work requeued, otherwise debug teardown runs, destructor if present consumes the work item, and parent if present is released.

Enrollment is refused when waiter marker is already set, otherwise it records arrival, marks waiting, adds combined waiter and reference units, and pushes onto the waitlist. Wake drains all waiters, restores arrival order by reversal, clears waiting marks, and subtracts combined units per waiter.

Global debug list and lifecycle markers are guarded by a spinlock with interrupt save and restore. Creation forbids double alive and then links as alive, destruction ignores stack objects and otherwise requires alive before marking dead and unlinking.
Observed synchronous waiter pairs a task pointer preset to current with an integer completion flag. List reversal proceeds by iterative relinking to a new head.

Blocking helpers attach a stack waiter and a wake callback, sleep uninterruptibly until completion is flagged, then restore running state. Timed waiting on expiry restores the count by atomic compare exchange only when progress is still pending and not running, reporting timeout otherwise. Return variant installs its callback, releases running state with adjusted count, sleeps only while references remain, then releases parent.
Guard bits set or zero reference with unexpected flags emit warnings, while debug magic violations are fatal. Timeout restoration must loop on compare exchange to avoid racing final release.

Word and short loads in checksums assume suitable alignment after initial steps and efficient unaligned support where used. Folio mappings must be unmapped and released exactly once, never retained across cleanup or reuse for another offset.
